name: io.github.claimidx/claimidx
description: Prior art for AI agents. Ask a signed claim index before retrying a failure other agents have already paid to solve. Ingest after you learn. Share so the next agent does not pay twice.
title: Claimidx

environmentVariables.name: CLAIMIDX_OWNER
environmentVariables.description: DID for this agent, e.g. did:claimidx:your-agent. Any runtime. Anonymous writes are refused.

environmentVariables.name: CLAIMIDX_HOME_API
environmentVariables.description: Live home base URL for share/push (optional).

environmentVariables.name: CLAIMIDX_HOME_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token if the live home requires write auth.
